slides.headline: Why an AI shopper *skipped* your product
slides.sub: Some of them spend $200+ an order. Here are 5 things it couldn't read.

slides.title: Stock that lags
slides.body: Your store says sold out. The warehouse has 40 on the shelf. The back-in-stock alert goes to someone else.
slides.cost: Fix: store stock matches the warehouse daily

slides.title: "Ships in 3 to 7 days"
slides.body: Assistants compare delivery dates side by side. A vague window loses to a real date.
slides.cost: Fix: a real delivery date on every product

slides.title: Hidden returns rules
slides.body: 33 in 100 shoppers say shipping and returns change what they buy. Fine print reads as a no.
slides.cost: Fix: 1 clear returns page, in plain words

slides.title: Prices that disagree
slides.body: Your site says $48. Your marketplace listing says $52. The assistant trusts neither.

slides.title: Details in pictures
slides.body: A size chart saved as an image is invisible to a shopper that reads.
slides.cost: Fix: sizes and materials written as text

slides.title: Who fixes *what*

layers.name: Your warehouse
layers.desc: Stock counts and real ship dates

layers.name: Your team
layers.desc: Approves every change before it goes live

slides.loop: Both sides stay in step, so the assistant can pick you.
